game.name: Sniper : Ghost Warrior 2 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It,Pl,Ru)
game.desc: Sniper: Ghost Warrior 2 on Xbox 360 is an FPS offering the player to play as a sniper, armed with a sniper rifle and a silenced handgun. Join an observation post, adjust your fire according to the distance and the wind, and clear the area of ​​any enemy presence.
